name: H3 two-sided decoded guide composition
operation: Select a source tail and source head, condition a fresh H3 target with two official guides, retain only the generated center, and concatenate explicit decoded ranges.

output_contract.name: joined_frames
output_contract.cardinality: left source plus accepted range plus right source

graph_contract.role: select the exact left tail range [left_count-guide_frames, left_count)
select the exact right head range [0, guide_frames)
create prompt conditioning and a fresh target of target_frames
place the selected left tail at frame zero
place the selected right head at target_frames-guide_frames
set explicit video and structural-audio flow shifts
sample and decode the complete fresh target
retain exactly [guide_frames, target_frames-guide_frames) from the decoded target
concatenate the complete left source and accepted generated range

evidence.deterministic_layer: CAUCE 3.0 decoded-range selection unit-validated; remaining assembly uses official/vanilla nodes
